help.title: How to play
help.clickSelect: Click a unit to select it
help.clickMove: Click a highlighted tile to move
help.clickAttack: Click an enemy to attack it
help.overwatchHint: Overwatch holds fire until an enemy moves
help.endTurnHint: End Turn, or Auto Turn to let the AI play

webglRequired.title: WEBGL REQUIRED
webglRequired.message: Tactical combat needs WebGL. Enable browser hardware acceleration or open the game in a browser/profile where WebGL is available, then reload and launch the battle again.
